texts.Connector_AccessSet_Description: Created by BarnCRM Connector. Holds only the principal access of each BarnCRM connection; given to Connector admins when they create or check a connection. Do not add other permissions.
texts.Connector_Access_Intro: Recipes run as the Automated Process user, never as a person. Tick the permission sets that user holds: they decide what every BarnCRM Automation recipe may read and write. BarnCRM Connections is added for you.
texts.Connector_Access_NotReady: Recipe Access cannot be saved: BarnCRM could not find the Automated Process user that recipes run as. Ask your system administrator.
texts.Connector_Access_NotSaved: Recipe Access has not been saved yet. The ticked sets are the suggested start: save them before your first recipe runs.
texts.Connector_Access_Unknown: That permission set cannot be given to recipes. Choose from the list.
texts.Connector_Clock_AutomationPaused: BarnCRM Automation Control is paused, so recipes are paused too. Resume it in BarnCRM Settings.
texts.Connector_Clock_Intro: Schedule and Record Change recipes run on the recipe clock: each Run As lane has a heartbeat that starts every 5 minutes while it has work. It runs as the lane's identity, never as a person, so it does not stop when someone leaves.
texts.Connector_Clock_PauseAllHelp: Org-wide. While on, no recipe starts a run; queued runs wait and Test runs from the editor still run.
texts.Connector_Clock_PausedNotice: Pause All Recipes is on. No recipe starts a run until you turn it off.
texts.Connector_Clock_PausedOff: Pause All Recipes is off. Waiting runs start now.
texts.Connector_Clock_Restarted: The clock was restarted for each lane with work.
texts.Connector_Confirm_Delete: Delete {0}? Its key and its credentials are removed from Salesforce.
texts.Connector_Confirm_Disconnect: Disconnect {0}? Its key is removed; the connection stays and can be given a new key.
texts.Connector_Editor_ConditionValue: Optional. A value path, such as trigger.email, fills this condition when the step runs; blank keeps the saved value.
texts.Connector_Editor_DeleteMessage: Delete {0}? The recipe and all of its runs are removed.
texts.Connector_Editor_DiscardMessage: Throw away the changes not yet published and start the draft again from the published version?
texts.Connector_Editor_Discarded: Draft changes discarded. The draft is the published version again.
texts.Connector_Editor_Exported: Recipe exported. Import the file on the Templates tab of another org. It holds no key, Run As or owner.
texts.Connector_Editor_FillHint: The import left these blank, because this org has no match: {0}. Fill them in to save.
texts.Connector_Editor_IgnoreOwnHelp: For Record Change: skip records last changed by a recipe, so a recipe that updates the records it watches does not start itself again.
texts.Connector_Editor_ItemsHelp: A value path to a list, such as steps.findPeople.records or trigger.items. The steps inside read each item as loop.item, and its place as loop.index. At most 1,000 items.
texts.Connector_Editor_KeepDaysHelp: 7 to 365. Finished runs older than this are deleted each night.
texts.Connector_Editor_LimitHelp: 1 to 200; blank is 200. More records wait for the next look.
texts.Connector_Editor_LimitsHelp: The step stages the rows and runs the Super Importer dry run first. It commits only when every count of the dry run is inside its limit; otherwise nothing is committed, the run fails and says why, and the data job waits in Super Importer for you to check.
texts.Connector_Editor_MostRowsHelp: 1 to 4,000. When more rows arrive, nothing is loaded and the run fails.
texts.Connector_Editor_NoSteps: No steps yet. Add the first one below.
texts.Connector_Editor_OwnerHelp: The user who owns records this recipe creates. Blank leaves them with the Automated Process user.
texts.Connector_Editor_PathHelp: What follows the connection base URL, starting with a slash, such as /contacts/{id}. Put a name in curly brackets for each value the step fills in.
texts.Connector_Editor_PathsHint: Value paths you can use here:
texts.Connector_Editor_PauseAfterHelp: 1 to 100. This many failed runs in a row pause the recipe.
texts.Connector_Editor_Paused: {0} is paused. Its queued runs wait.
texts.Connector_Editor_Problems: Fix These Before Testing or Publishing
texts.Connector_Editor_Published: Published as version {0}. The recipe is Active.
texts.Connector_Editor_RetryAttemptsHelp: 0 to 4. A run that failed for a reason that may pass is tried again after 15 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours and 12 hours.
texts.Connector_Editor_RollBackMessage: Publish the version before the last one again? It is checked as Publish checks a draft. Your draft stays as it is, and Roll Back again returns to the current version.
texts.Connector_Editor_RolledBack: Rolled back. The earlier version is published as version {0}.
texts.Connector_Editor_RowsHelp: The value that holds the rows: a list of records keyed by column name, a list of lists whose first list holds the column names (a Google Sheets range), or CSV text with a header row. At most 4,000 rows.
texts.Connector_Editor_RunAsHelp: BarnCRM Automation runs with Recipe Access. System skips permission and sharing checks. Integration User runs as the user chosen on Recipe Clock, and is offered once one is chosen.
texts.Connector_Editor_SampleHelp: What a run receives, such as the JSON you would paste for Run Now or a flow Data value. Test uses it, and its keys appear as trigger value paths.
texts.Connector_Editor_SaveFirst: Save the draft to choose Run As.
texts.Connector_Editor_Saved: Draft saved. Publish to make it the version that runs.
texts.Connector_Editor_SendForReal: Send requests for real (other than GET)
texts.Connector_Editor_StopIfNone: Stop the run as Skipped when nothing is found
texts.Connector_Editor_SuccessHelp: Status codes that count as success, separated by commas. Blank is any 2xx.
texts.Connector_Editor_TemplateHelp: An active Super Importer template. Its columns, matching and transforms load the rows, exactly as for an uploaded file.
texts.Connector_Editor_TestIntro: Saves the draft and runs it once on the sample data, or on the record Id you enter. Nothing is saved, and only GET requests are sent unless you tick the box.
texts.Connector_Editor_TestQueued: The test was queued. Select Check Result in a moment.
texts.Connector_Editor_TransformHelp: A saved map that builds JSON. Later steps read what it builds by the step name, such as steps.reshape.fullName. Nothing is saved.
texts.Connector_Editor_UrlFromHelp: Optional. A value path to a full address on this connection's own host, such as trigger.api_url or trigger.response_url, used in place of the path. An address on any other host fails the step.
texts.Connector_Editor_ValueHelp: A fixed value, or a value path such as trigger.email or steps.find1.records[0].Id.
texts.Connector_Editor_WaitHelp: From 5 minutes to 30 days. The recipe clock carries the run on, up to 5 minutes after the wait ends.
texts.Connector_Editor_WebhookPathHelp: Optional. What follows the connection's address, starting with a slash. Blank posts to the connection's own address.
texts.Connector_Editor_WhenAppPoll: Runs for new or changed items in another app's list. The clock asks the app through a connection every 15 minutes; the first look after you publish only notes the newest item. The steps read each item under trigger.item, or all of them under trigger.items.
texts.Connector_Editor_WhenManual: Runs when you select Run Now, or when a flow uses the action Run a BarnCRM Connector Recipe.
texts.Connector_Editor_WhenRecord: Runs for records that match a saved Find query. The clock looks every 15 minutes, starting from when you publish; deleted records are not seen.
texts.Connector_Editor_WhenSchedule: Runs on the recipe clock, in your org's time zone. The steps read the time it was due as trigger.scheduledAt.
texts.Connector_Editor_WhenWebhook: Runs when another app posts data to this recipe's webhook address. The steps read the posted JSON under trigger, such as trigger.amount.
texts.Connector_Erase_TooManyRuns: BarnCRM Connector could not be sure of finding every recipe run that names this person: its search found {0} or more. Lower Keep Runs Days on the recipes that handle this person, so the nightly cleanup deletes their older runs, then erase the person again.
texts.Connector_Error_HeaderName: Enter the header name the app reads, such as X-Api-Key: letters, digits and hyphens, at most 64. Authorization is set by the Bearer Token and Basic kinds.
texts.Connector_Error_HostChanged: The new address must keep the same host. To use another host, create a new connection.
texts.Connector_Error_InUse: A recipe uses this connection. Take it out of every recipe first, then delete it.
texts.Connector_Error_Label: Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters.
texts.Connector_Error_NoCredentialPermission: Saving a key needs Customize Application or Manage Named Credentials as well as BarnCRM Connector Admin. Ask your system administrator.
texts.Connector_Error_NoManage: Managing connections needs BarnCRM Connector Admin. Ask your system administrator.
texts.Connector_Error_NoView: Seeing recipes needs BarnCRM Connector Viewer or Admin. Ask your system administrator.
texts.Connector_Error_NotOurs: That is not a BarnCRM connection, so it was not changed.
texts.Connector_Error_SaveFailed: Salesforce did not save the connection. The Error Log has the details, without the key, and names anything left to delete in Setup.
texts.Connector_Error_Unexpected: Something went wrong. The Error Log has the details.
texts.Connector_Error_Url: Enter an address that starts with https:// and has no user name, password, query or spaces.
texts.Connector_Flow_NoRecipe: No Active recipe named {0} can be run from a flow. Check the name on Super Connector and publish the recipe.
texts.Connector_Flow_NoSource: The source record was not found, or you cannot see it.
texts.Connector_Flow_NotRecordMap: That map builds a JSON body, not a record. Choose a map whose target is a record.
texts.Connector_Flow_TooMany: Too many records in one flow step, so this one was not saved. Run the flow on fewer records at a time.
texts.Connector_Form_BaseUrlHelp: The address every request starts with, such as https://api.example.org/v2. Its host cannot change later.
texts.Connector_Form_DebugNotice: Enter keys only when no debug logging is on for you. If a trace flag was on while you entered a key, replace the key.
texts.Connector_Form_ErrorLockedUrl: Fill in each part of the address the template asks for, matching its pattern.
texts.Connector_Form_SecretUrlNotice: Salesforce cannot encrypt an address, so a Secret URL is stored as the Named Credential URL and every administrator who can view Setup can read it. Where the app offers a token instead, choose Bearer Token.
texts.Connector_Form_UrlPartFromKey: {0} Leave blank to read it from your key when you save.
texts.Connector_Health_AccessMissing_Detail: These connections are missing from the BarnCRM Connections permission set, so no callout can use them: {0}. Select Check Again on Super Connector, or add their principals to the set in Setup.
texts.Connector_Health_AccessSetExtra_Detail: The BarnCRM Connections permission set grants more than connection access, and every Connector admin holds it. Remove the other permissions in Setup, Permission Sets, BarnCRM Connections.
texts.Connector_Health_AllPaused_Detail: Pause All Recipes is on in Super Connector, so no recipe starts a run. Turn it off on Recipe Clock when you are ready.
texts.Connector_Health_CalloutsOff_Detail: Callouts are still off for these connections: {0}. In Setup, Named Credentials, edit each one, tick Enabled for Callouts and save, then select Check Again on Super Connector.
texts.Connector_Health_CalloutsOff_Title: Connections Waiting for Their Setup Step
texts.Connector_Health_ClockStopped_Detail: The {0} lane has Schedule, Record Change or waiting runs, but its heartbeat is not going, so they do not start. Open Super Connector, Recipes, Recipe Clock and select Restart Clock.
texts.Connector_Health_KeysReplaced_Detail: A key was replaced in the last 7 days for: {0}. If nobody here meant to, check the account each key belongs to; the Admin Journal says who replaced it.
texts.Connector_Health_OwnerInactive_Detail: These Active recipes give the records they create to an inactive user: {0}. Choose an active Owner of New Records on each.
texts.Connector_Health_PausedByFailures_Detail: These recipes failed too many times in a row and were paused: {0}. Read their failed runs in Run History, fix the cause, then Resume each.
texts.Connector_Health_RecipeAccess_Detail: Active recipes run as BarnCRM Automation, but Recipe Access has never been saved, so their record steps can be refused. Open Super Connector, then Recipe Access on the Recipes tab, and save the permission sets recipes may use.
texts.Connector_Health_RunsWaiting_Detail: {0} recipe runs have been queued for more than {1} minutes. If you changed the integration user, Suspend and Resume the Connector Start User subscription in Setup; otherwise select Restart Clock on Recipe Clock.
texts.Connector_Health_SystemRecipes_Detail: These recipes read and write without permission or sharing checks: {0}. Check that each still needs System; BarnCRM Automation is safer.
texts.Connector_Health_UserAccess_Detail: {0} does not hold BarnCRM Connections, so Integration User recipes cannot call your apps. Save the integration user again on Recipe Clock.
texts.Connector_Health_UserInactive_Detail: {0}, the integration user, is inactive, so these recipes do not run: {1}. Choose another user on Recipe Clock, then Suspend and Resume the Connector Start User subscription in Setup.
texts.Connector_Health_UserNotChosen_Detail: These Active recipes run as the integration user, but none is chosen, so they do not run: {0}. Choose one on Super Connector, Recipes, Recipe Clock.
texts.Connector_Health_WebhookGuest_Detail: The guest user of these Sites does not hold BarnCRM Connector Webhook Guest, so posts to their webhook addresses are refused: {0}.
texts.Connector_Health_WebhookGuest_Done: Gave webhook access to the guest user of: {0}.
texts.Connector_Health_WebhookNoSite_Detail: A published recipe receives webhooks, but your org has no active Salesforce Site, so no app can reach it. In Setup, Sites, create and activate a Site (Experience Cloud is not needed), then give its guest user webhook access from Health Check.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorAction: The action {0} of the template needs a known name, a method and a path that starts with one slash. Nothing was imported.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorAuth: The sign-in kind or header name of the template ({0}) is not one BarnCRM offers. Nothing was imported.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorBatchGone: The data job this step started is gone, so the step cannot finish. Retry the run to load the rows again.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorCommit: The commit of data job {0} ended {1}. Open it in Super Importer to see its rows, retry them or undo it.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorDryRun: The dry run of data job {0} ended {1}, so nothing was committed. Open it in Super Importer to see why.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorFormula: The file tries to set a sign-in header or turn on formulas ({0}). Templates use only the built-in sign-in kinds of BarnCRM. Nothing was imported.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorKey: The file holds {0}, which BarnCRM does not read. Nothing was imported.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorMergeField: The file holds a Salesforce merge field, which BarnCRM never imports. Nothing was imported.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorMissing: The recipes of the template need {0}, which this org does not have. Install the module first. Nothing was imported.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorOverLimit: The dry run of data job {0} would {1}, more than the limit of {2} set on this step, so nothing was committed. Check the job in Super Importer and commit it there, or fix the source and retry the run.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorParam: The address part {0} of the template needs a pattern its value must match. Nothing was imported.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorPermission: Load Rows needs the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission that Super Importer asks for. Give the recipe identity BarnCRM Admin in Recipe Access, or give BarnCRM Admin to the integration user.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorRecipe: A recipe in the file has a problem Save would refuse. {0} Nothing was imported.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorRowsUnreadable: The rows could not be read. Give a list of records keyed by column name, a list of lists whose first list holds the column names, or CSV text with a header row.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorSecret: The file holds what looks like a key, token, password or secret ({0}). Templates and recipe files never carry one: remove it, and paste the key on the connection instead. Nothing was imported.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorSize: Choose or paste a file of at most 400,000 characters.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorTemplateGone: The import template is gone, inactive or hidden from the recipe, so nothing was loaded.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorTooLong: Data job {0} was still running after 24 hours. Check it in Super Importer, then retry the run.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorTooManyRows: {0} rows arrived, more than the {1} this step allows (Most Rows), so nothing was loaded.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorUnreadable: This is not a BarnCRM template or recipe file, or a part of it is not in the form BarnCRM reads. Nothing was imported.
texts.Connector_Import_ErrorUrl: The address of the template ({0}) must start with https:// and hold its parts in the host only. Nothing was imported.
texts.Connector_Import_Loaded: Data job {0}: {1} rows, {2} created, {3} updated, {4} rejected.
texts.Connector_Import_NoRows: No rows arrived, so nothing was loaded.
texts.Connector_IntegrationUser_ErrorChoice: Choose an active user with a Salesforce license.
texts.Connector_IntegrationUser_ErrorTooMuch: Choose a user who is not a System Administrator and holds neither Modify All Data nor View All Data. Recipes run as this user, so give it only what Recipe Access grants.
texts.Connector_Log_AccessRefused: Salesforce refused to add the principal of connection {0} to the BarnCRM Connections permission set ({1}). The Super Connector page shows the Setup step.
texts.Connector_Log_BeatFailed: The recipe clock stopped unexpectedly ({0}) and was started again.
texts.Connector_Log_Paused: Recipe {0} failed {1} times in a row, so it was paused. Fix the cause, then select Resume on the recipe.
texts.Connector_Log_PollFailed: Recipe {0} could not run or look for changes: {1} It tries again in 15 minutes.
texts.Connector_Log_SubscriberFailed: BarnCRM could not write the Integration User subscriber setting ({0}). Check the org connection, then save the integration user again.
texts.Connector_Log_UndoFailed: A connection that failed to save left credentials named {0}. Delete them in Setup, Named Credentials.
texts.Connector_Log_Unreachable: Check Connection could not reach the app of connection {0} ({1}).
texts.Connector_Log_WebhookCap: Recipe {0} reached its Webhook Hourly Cap of {1} posts, so more are refused with 429 until the hour passes. If the posts are expected, raise the cap on the Webhook card of the recipe.
texts.Connector_Log_WebhookFailed: The Connector webhook receiver could not store a post ({0}) and answered 500. The sending app usually tries again.
texts.Connector_Log_WebhookStore: The webhook post could not be stored.
texts.Connector_Log_WriteFailed: A connection key was not saved ({0}): {1}
texts.Connector_Log_WrongIdentity: A Connector job started as someone other than a recipe identity (the Automated Process user or the integration user), so it stopped without running anything. The runs stay queued.
texts.Connector_Log_WrongLane: A Connector start event for the {0} lane ran as someone other than the identity of that lane, so nothing started. If you just chose the integration user, Suspend and Resume the Connector Start User subscription in Setup.
texts.Connector_Outcome_AccessAdded: You were given access to this connection. Select Check Again to call the app.
texts.Connector_Outcome_AccessMissing: Salesforce did not let BarnCRM add this connection to the BarnCRM Connections permission set. Follow the steps shown, then select Check Again.
texts.Connector_Outcome_Answered: The app answered with status {0}. Check the base URL and the app documentation.
texts.Connector_Outcome_CalloutsOff: Callouts are still off for this connection. Follow the Setup step shown, then select Check Again.
texts.Connector_Outcome_Connected: Connected: the app accepted the key (status {0}).
texts.Connector_Outcome_Created: Connection created. Turn on its callouts in Setup as shown, then select Check Again.
texts.Connector_Outcome_CreatedAccessMissing: Connection created, but Salesforce did not let BarnCRM add it to the BarnCRM Connections permission set. Follow the steps shown.
texts.Connector_Outcome_Disconnected: Disconnected. The key is removed; replace it to use the connection again.
texts.Connector_Outcome_KeyRefused: Key refused: the app answered with status {0}. Replace the key.
texts.Connector_Outcome_Replaced: Key replaced. The change is recorded in the Admin Journal.
texts.Connector_Outcome_Unreachable: The app could not be reached. Check the base URL; the Error Log has the details.
texts.Connector_Page_Empty: No connections yet. Select New Connection to connect an app.
texts.Connector_Page_Intro: Connect BarnCRM to other apps and run recipes that move data between them. Each key is kept in Salesforce credentials and never shown again.
texts.Connector_Page_NoWrite: You can check connections. Creating them and saving keys needs Customize Application or Manage Named Credentials as well.
texts.Connector_Poll_ErrorItems: The answer from the app has no list of items at {0}. Check Item List under When.
texts.Connector_Poll_ErrorStamp: An item stamp is longer than {0} characters, so it cannot be kept as the watermark. Choose a shorter stamp, such as a time or a growing number.
texts.Connector_Poll_ItemIdHelp: Where each item keeps its id, such as id or contact.id.
texts.Connector_Poll_ItemsHelp: Where the list sits in the app's answer, such as members or data.items. Leave it blank when the answer is the list itself.
texts.Connector_Poll_LimitHelp: 1 to 200; blank is 200. More items wait for the next look; items sharing the last one's stamp are kept together.
texts.Connector_Poll_PathHelp: What follows the connection base URL for the app's list, starting with a slash, such as /lists/{listId}/members. Put a name in curly brackets for each value filled in below.
texts.Connector_Poll_StampHelp: Where each item keeps the time it last changed, such as last_changed, or a number that only grows. Items whose stamp is after the newest one already seen start runs, so the stamp must sort: one time format, or a number.
texts.Connector_Poll_ValueHelp: A fixed value, or trigger.watermark for the stamp of the newest item already seen, such as for a changed-since parameter. Before the first look, a parameter set to trigger.watermark is left out.
texts.Connector_Publish_Connection: The connection {0} is not ready: it needs a key and its callouts turned on. Fix it on the Connections tab, then publish.
texts.Connector_Publish_FieldAccess: Recipes cannot edit {0}. Give recipes a permission set that grants it under Recipe Access, or take it out of the map.
texts.Connector_Publish_MapKind: Step {0}: the map {1} does not fit this step. A record step needs a map whose target is a record; Call an App needs a map that builds a JSON body.
texts.Connector_Publish_MapMatch: Step {0}: the map {1} has no match by record Id, field or external Id, so Create or Update cannot find a record. Set its match in Mapper.
texts.Connector_Publish_MapMergeField: The map {0} holds a Salesforce merge field, which recipes never send. Remove it in Mapper.
texts.Connector_Publish_NoStamp: Records of {0} cannot be watched for changes: the object has no created or changed date.
texts.Connector_Publish_ObjectAccess: Recipes cannot create or edit {0} records. Give recipes a permission set that grants it under Recipe Access.
texts.Connector_Publish_Template: Step {0}: its import template is gone, inactive, or deletes records by file, which a recipe cannot do. Choose another template.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorAppPoll: Choose a connection, a list path starting with a slash, where each item keeps its id and its stamp, one run per item or one for all, and at most 200 items per look. Each value is fixed, or trigger.watermark.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorCodes: Step {0}: success codes must be whole numbers from 100 to 599.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorCondition: Step {0}: give 1 to 10 conditions, each with a value from an earlier step and an operator.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorFill: Step {0}: fill in what the import left blank, highlighted on the step.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorGone: That recipe was deleted, or you cannot see it. Refresh the page.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorHeader: Step {0}: a header needs a name of letters, digits and hyphens and a value. Authorization and the other sign-in headers come from the connection, never from a step.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorInLoop: Step {0}: a For Each cannot hold a For Each, Wait or Load Rows step.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorItems: Step {0}: choose the list to work through, from the trigger or an earlier step.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorLimits: Step {0}: each limit is a whole number from 0 to 4,000, and Most Rows is at least 1.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorMergeField: A recipe cannot hold a Salesforce merge field. Remove it and save again.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorMethod: Step {0}: choose GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorNameTaken: Another recipe has that name. Choose another.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorNesting: Step {0}: an If or For Each step can hold another If or For Each step only once.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorNoPrevious: There is no earlier version to roll back to.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorNotPaused: Only a paused recipe can be resumed.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorNotPublished: This recipe has never been published, so there are no draft changes to discard.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorOwner: Choose an active user as the owner of the records recipes create, or leave it blank.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorPath: Step {0}: choose a value from the trigger or an earlier step.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorQuery: Step {0}: each query parameter needs a name of letters, digits, dots, brackets and underscores and a value on one line.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorRecordId: Step {0}: choose the record to update from the trigger or an earlier step.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorRecordTrigger: Choose a saved Find query, whether new records or new and changed records start runs, one run per record or one for all, and at most 200 records per look.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorRequestPath: Step {0}: the path must start with one slash and hold no spaces, at signs, backslashes, question marks or hash signs. Put query parameters in their own list.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorSchedule: Choose how often the schedule runs (every 15 minutes, hour, day or week), a time such as 08:00 for a day or a week, and a day for a week.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorSignInHeader: Step {0}: the header {1} looks like a sign-in header, so it cannot hold a typed value. Keys belong on the connection; a value from the trigger or an earlier step is allowed.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorSlot: Step {0}: every slot in the path (a name in curly brackets) needs exactly one value, and every value needs its slot.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorStepId: Step {0}: each step needs its own name of 1 to 20 letters, digits or underscores.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorStepKind: Step {0}: that kind of step is not available yet.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorStop: Step {0}: choose how the run ends (Succeeded, Skipped or Failed) and keep the message to 255 characters.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorTooManySteps: A recipe can hold at most 25 steps.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorUnreadable: The recipe could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorWait: Step {0}: wait a whole number of minutes, hours or days, from 5 minutes to 30 days.
texts.Connector_Recipe_ErrorWebhook: The webhook settings are not valid: Event Id must be a value path, Reply Status 200 or 202, Reply Body JSON of at most 4,000 characters, and Challenge Field a name of letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores other than token.
texts.Connector_Recipes_Intro: When something happens, a recipe finds, creates and updates records and calls your apps, step by step.
texts.Connector_Row_AccessSteps: In Setup, Permission Sets, BarnCRM Connections, External Credential Principal Access, select Edit, add {0}, and save. Then select Check Again.
texts.Connector_Row_CalloutSteps: In Setup, search for Named Credentials, select {0}, then Edit. Tick Enabled for Callouts, save, and select Check Again here.
texts.Connector_RunAs_ConfirmMessage: {0} will read and write without any permission or sharing check. Who chose this and when is recorded, and Health Check lists it. Choose System only when Recipe Access cannot give the recipe what it needs.
texts.Connector_RunAs_ErrorChoice: Choose BarnCRM Automation, System or Integration User.
texts.Connector_RunAs_ErrorConfirm: Confirm that this recipe may skip every permission and sharing check before choosing System.
texts.Connector_RunAs_ErrorNoUser: Choose an active integration user on Recipe Clock first.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorAccess: The recipe is not allowed to do this. Check Recipe Access, or the permission sets it gives.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorAppDown: The app had a problem (status {0}). Retry later.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorDataAddress: The address read from the data was not used, so nothing was sent: it must be https, on this step's connection's own host and port, under the connection's own path, with no user name.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorField: The map names a field that is not on the record: {0}. Fix the map in Mapper.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorFieldAccess: The recipe cannot edit {0}. Check Recipe Access.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorInput: The data is not valid JSON. Check it and try again.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorLookup: The lookup {0} in the map cannot be found by the value given. Fix the map in Mapper.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorLookupNone: No record matched {1} for the lookup {0}.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorLookupSeveral: Several records matched {1} for the lookup {0}, so none was chosen.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorMapGone: The saved map was deleted, or the recipe cannot see it.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorMapObject: The map builds a record of an object that is not in this org. Fix the map in Mapper.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorMatch: The map cannot find an existing record: its match field is missing, empty or cannot be searched.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorMatchNone: No existing record matched, and the map rejects a new one.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorMatchSeveral: Several existing records matched, and the map rejects more than one.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorMergeField: A value held a Salesforce merge field, so the request was not sent.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorNoDefinition: The recipe has no published version. Publish it, then run it again.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorNotActive: Only an Active recipe can be run. Publish it first.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorNotFailed: Only a failed run can be retried.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorNotFound: The app could not find what was asked for (status 404).
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorNotList: For Each needs a list, and the value it was given is not one.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorRecordId: The record to update is missing or is not a record of the map object.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorRefused: The app refused the key (status {0}). Replace the key on the Connections tab.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorRequest: The request could not be built: a value for the path or a header was empty or not allowed.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorRequired: The map needs a value for {0}, and none was found.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorResponseTooLarge: The answer from the app was too large to keep.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorStepTooLarge: Step {0} brought back too much to keep. Find fewer records, or ask the app for less.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorStopped: The run stopped unexpectedly ({0}). Retry it.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorTooLarge: The run grew too large to keep. Find fewer records or keep less from each step.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorTooMany: The app asked to slow down (status 429). Retry later.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorTooManyItems: The list holds {0} items. For Each works through at most {1} in a run.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorUnexpected: Something unexpected went wrong ({0}). It is in the Error Log.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorUnreachable: The app could not be reached ({0}). Check the connection, then retry.
texts.Connector_Run_ErrorValue: A value does not fit {0}. Check the map in Mapper.
texts.Connector_Run_NoneFound: Nothing was found, so the run stopped as Skipped.
texts.Connector_Run_VersionChanged: Continued on version {1}; it started on version {0}.
texts.Connector_Run_WouldWait: Would wait {0} minutes. A test does not wait.
texts.Connector_Runs_Detail: Started by {0}, ran as {1}, version {2}, {3} records written
texts.Connector_Runs_Intro: The latest 50 runs of every recipe, newest first. Open one to see each step.
texts.Connector_Runs_Retried: {0} was queued again from its failed step.
texts.Connector_Settings_ErrorRange: Retry Attempts must be 0 to 4, Pause After Failures 1 to 100 and Keep Runs Days 7 to 365.
texts.Connector_Step_ImportRows: Load Rows with an Import Template
texts.Connector_Templates_Intro: Import a template file for an app, or a recipe exported from another org, from your computer or pasted below. Nothing is preloaded and nothing of the file is kept: only the connection and recipes you save stay in your org.
texts.Connector_Templates_NothingKept: Nothing has been saved. Create the connection and open each recipe as a draft, then save what you want to keep.
texts.Connector_Templates_PasteHelp: The whole JSON file, as text. A file never holds a key: you paste the key on the connection.
texts.Connector_Test_ErrorRecordId: Enter a record Id of 15 or 18 characters, or leave it blank to use the sample.
texts.Connector_User_Cleared: Saved with no user. Integration User recipes do not run until you choose one.
texts.Connector_User_Confirmed: Confirmed: a job ran as {0} in the last 7 days.
texts.Connector_User_Inactive: {0} is inactive, so Integration User recipes do not run. Choose another user.
texts.Connector_User_Intro: Integration User recipes run as this user, with its own permission sets. Choose an active user with a Salesforce license, kept for recipes only.
texts.Connector_User_NoConnections: {0} does not hold BarnCRM Connections yet. Wait a moment and reopen Recipe Clock, or save the user again.
texts.Connector_User_NotConfirmed: Not confirmed yet: no job has run as {0}. Finish the Setup step below, then wait for the next run.
texts.Connector_User_OrgConnection: The org connection is not set up, so BarnCRM cannot write the subscriber setting. Set it up first, as the Admin Guide page Creating a New Field From an Import describes.
texts.Connector_User_Saved: Saved. BarnCRM is writing the subscriber setting and giving the user BarnCRM Connections; finish with the Setup step below.
texts.Connector_User_Steps: After saving, in Setup open Platform Events, then Connector Start User. Under Subscriptions, select Suspend on the trigger's row, then Resume. The user takes effect at once.
texts.Connector_Webhook_AddressWithToken: Address With Token, Only for Apps That Cannot Send Headers
texts.Connector_Webhook_ChallengeHelp: Optional. For an app that checks a new address by sending a value it expects back: the name of that field. Its value is sent back as plain text.
texts.Connector_Webhook_ConfirmBody: The current token stops working at once. Every app that posts to this recipe then needs the new one.
texts.Connector_Webhook_ErrorCap: Webhook Hourly Cap must be a whole number from 1 to 5,000.
texts.Connector_Webhook_EventIdHelp: Optional. A value path to the post's own id, such as trigger.id, so a post the app sends again is not run twice.
texts.Connector_Webhook_FetchBack: Anyone with the token can post data. When the app has an API, make the first step a Call an App GET that reads the item back from the app (by its id, or with Address From the Data), so the recipe writes what the app says, not what was posted.
texts.Connector_Webhook_HasToken: A token is set. It cannot be shown again; New Webhook Token replaces it.
texts.Connector_Webhook_HourlyCapHelp: Posts kept in any hour, 1 to 5,000. More are refused with 429, and the app usually tries again later.
texts.Connector_Webhook_Intro: Give the other app this address and the token. Send the token in the header wherever the app allows custom headers: an address holding the token can be written to the app's logs.
texts.Connector_Webhook_NoSite: Your org has no active Salesforce Site yet, so there is no webhook address. The Admin Guide page BarnCRM Connector, Webhooks: Data Sent In, shows how to add one.
texts.Connector_Webhook_NoToken: No token yet: every post is refused until you make one.
texts.Connector_Webhook_ReplyBodyHelp: Fixed JSON sent back at once, at most 4,000 characters. The word reference in curly brackets becomes the run's reference. It cannot hold a record or a result, because the steps have not run yet.
texts.Connector_Webhook_SaveFirst: Save the draft to get a webhook address and token.
texts.Connector_Webhook_TokenShown: Copy the token now. It is shown only this once.
texts.Connector_WhereUsed_Breaks: The recipe fails at that step when it runs.
